governedSurface.audit: Local hash-chained JSONL (lib/audit-log.mjs); host injects auditPath; verifyAudit() exposes chain verification.
governedSurface.csamDiscipline: Input and result screening on every call; a hit aborts instantly, is logged WITHOUT content, and has no override path (same discipline as darkweb-search).
governedSurface.fullMethodsPosture: Tap-gated stubs: every call requires a verified founder tap token; absent/invalid token refuses and the refusal is audit-logged. Wiring a live non-public source is a founder act, never an install default.
neverInAnyBuild: password resets / credential stuffing / account takeover
camera tracking of individuals / live surveillance
governedSurface.transport: Injected by the host; the module ships no network code and no telemetry. No transport = public methods refuse (fail-closed).
